title: Vintage Filet Square Motif
author: Robin / Hooked by Robin
notes: start: original 'Make a magic ring or ch 4 and sl st to join.' shortened to magic ring. 'Row N:' headings normalised to 'Round N:' and each round's lines (incl. 'Sl st to join.') joined onto one line; 'Rows 4-onward:' written as 'Round 4: (onward)'. Round 1 ch-5 = 1 dc + ch 2.
